负荷口径为 Garmin 活动训练负荷，只适合看相对趋势，不能与功率 TSS 的: Load is Garmin activity training load: use it for relative trends, not as an absolute TSS value. CTL is seeded from 2020; the empty 2025 period decays naturally.
CTL 是 42 天慢速平均（基础体能），ATL 是 7 天快速平均（近期疲劳）: CTL is a 42-day slow average (fitness); ATL is a 7-day fast average (fatigue).
TSB = CTL − ATL。持续为负说明在累积疲劳，明显转正说明状态在恢复: TSB = CTL − ATL. A sustained negative value means accumulating fatigue; a clear positive value means recovery.
7 天负荷 ÷ 28 天日均负荷。0.8–1.3 通常较安全，超过 1.5 时受: 7-day load ÷ 28-day average. 0.8–1.3 is usually safer; above 1.5 injury risk rises. Not calculated when there are fewer than 8 training days in 28, to avoid sparse-data spikes above 3.
步数带每日目标线；Body Battery 是区间带（每日最高到最低）: Steps include the daily goal line; Body Battery is a daily high–low band.
深浅之间的带状区域 = 一天的能量波动范围: The shaded band = the day's energy range
结构图看深睡/浅睡/REM 的配比，评分图看整体质量趋势: The structure chart shows deep/light/REM balance; the score chart shows overall quality.
每晚各睡眠阶段的时长（小时）: Time in each sleep stage per night (hours)
0–100，Garmin 按时长/深睡/压力综合计算: 0–100, calculated by Garmin from duration, deep sleep and stress
这三项放一起看：心率抬高、HRV 走低、压力偏高，同时出现就该减量: Read these together: rising resting HR, falling HRV and high stress at the same time mean it is time to deload.
近 90 天睡眠数据。睡眠时间从原始时间戳重算（旧库里的 +8 小时偏移不影响本: Last 90 days of sleep. Sleep times are recomputed from raw GMT timestamps (the +8 h offset in the old DB does not affect this page). Correlations are observational; small samples do not prove causation.
Garmin 按训练负荷、HRV 与近期睡眠史动态调整需求，单位小时: Garmin adjusts need from training load, HRV and recent sleep history (hours).
实际睡眠中点 vs 理想窗口中点；两条线越接近，作息越规律: Actual sleep midpoint vs the ideal window midpoint; closer lines mean a more regular schedule.
每次训练结束时间与当晚入睡时间的关系: Training end time vs bedtime that night.
前一夜睡眠评分与次日训练负荷的关系: Previous night's sleep score vs next-day training load.
次数与时长分开看——次数多但时长短，说明以短课为主: Read count and duration separately: many short sessions means a short-session pattern.
Garmin 的活动训练负荷，柱子越高越累: Garmin activity training load; taller bars mean more fatigue
动作明细来自手表上按组记录的部分——没在表上按下的组不会出现: Exercise detail comes from sets recorded on the watch; sets you did not log are missing.
组数 × 次数 × 重量之和，单位 kg；自重动作不计入: Sets × reps × weight, in kg; bodyweight work is not counted
每次训练里该动作的最大重量；动作名优先按手表的子类别区分（腿举 ≠ 深蹲）: Max weight per session; exercise names prefer the watch subcategory (leg press ≠ squat).
动作明细来自手表上按组记录的部分。肌肉图红色 = 主要锻炼，黄色 = 次要；周视: Exercise detail comes from sets recorded on the watch. Red = primary, yellow = secondary; the weekly view is coloured by effective sets. Click a day for exercises, then an exercise for equipment and history. Strength records start on 2026-10-30; weekly advice needs 3–4 weeks to stabilise.
按自然周（周一起算），有效组 = 主要动作 1 组计 1、次要动作 0.5 组: Calendar week (Monday start); effective sets = 1 for a primary set, 0.5 for a secondary set.
全部由规则从你近 90 天的数据推出来，每条都附判断依据: Generated by rules from the last 90 days; every item includes its basis.
最近 16 天，数字与上面的图同源: Last 16 days; same source as the charts.
近 90 天全部活动: All activities in the last 90 days
数据来自 Garmin Connect 个人 API（只读）。本页为静态文件，所: Data comes from the Garmin Connect Personal API (read-only). This is a static file with all data embedded; nothing is uploaded.

以上判断基于公开的通用运动生理与睡眠卫生原则，只作为自我观察的参考，: These notes use general exercise-physiology and sleep-hygiene principles as self-observation references only;
不能替代医生或专业教练的意见。若出现持续心悸、胸痛、异常气短、血氧长期偏低等情况: they do not replace a doctor or coach. Seek medical care for persistent palpitations, chest pain, unusual breathlessness or chronically low SpO2.
区间内还没有力量训练记录: No strength sessions in this range
手表没有识别出器械，未计入肌肉图。下次训练可在手表上先选器械再按组。: The watch did not recognise the machine, so it is not in the muscle map. Pick the exercise on the watch before logging sets next time.
个人 API 只返回该动作的汇总（组数 / 总次数 / 最大重量 / 容量），没: The Personal API returns exercise totals (sets / reps / max weight / volume), not per-set detail. Estimated 1RM uses Epley (weight × (1 + reps/30)) from average reps per set; use it as a trend only. History merges by exercise subcategory.
